## Fix

- ComputerPilot can identify and focus Chrome windows on macOS when the Accessibility title includes a browser or profile suffix. If the titles differ, the window bounds must identify a single window in both the Core Graphics and Accessibility lists for that process.

## Downloads

| Archive | Platform |
|---|---|
| `ComputerPilot-windows-x64-core.zip` | Windows x64 |
| `ComputerPilot-macos-arm64-core.tar.gz` | macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, unsigned and not notarized |

Verify the archives against `SHA256SUMS.txt` and follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/ClarkWain/ComputerPilot/blob/v0.6.2/docs/INSTALLATION.md).
